title: Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
abstract: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average across MindCube, SPARBench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial, outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Ablations confirm the complementarity of 3D and answer privilege, the advantage of question-conditioned routing over full-context injection, and the benefit of restricting distillation to incorrect trajectories.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.12355v2 的 13 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：available。 本次实质更新：9→13页，main methods/results不变；新增Table4 matched训练成本(+30.8%)、Fig9 response dynamics及显式cue/router/teacher/scale limitations，补可复现协议。
analysis.ideaZh: GPD v2 沿用已收录的 routed 3D privilege+answer self-distillation：只在错误student trajectories上加teacher KL，部署仍RGB-only。本次新增有意义的成本/边界证据：作者报告训练从GRPO57.1h增至74.6h（+30.8%），peak memory几乎不变，并补cue/router错误、teacher noise和15K scale限制。旧main benchmark分数没有新提升；『无推理额外成本』不能写成『无额外成本』，短response也不是内部3D机制的因果证明。
analysis.motivationZh: RGB空间错误来自perception，outcome-only RL不定位中间几何错误，而test-time 3D增加部署成本。
analysis.methodZh: VSI/SPAR由ScanNet annotations提取text depth/semantics/BEV；MindCube由Depth Anything3与Grounded-SAM2估cue，因缺可靠pose禁止BEV。question-only base-VLM router离线挑cue，fallback到dataset task mapping。相同参数VLM在RGB student与cue+reference-answer teacher contexts打分，以GRPO+仅incorrect(R<.5) trajectories的single-sample reverse KL训练，microbatch scalar clip1.5，λ.003。v2新增4页supplement，完整prompt/reward/training/eval settings、response length curve、matched cost table与显式limitations。
methodFlow: 从scan annotations或估计模型生成离线depth/semantic/可靠BEV text，保留frame IDs与valid masks。
question-conditioned routing固定cue，teacher context附reference answer；student只RGB+question。
student采样8rollouts并算outcome GRPO；teacher沿相同student tokens重新评分。
错误轨迹KL单样本估计在microbatch聚合后clip1.5，与GRPO联合更新。
推理只RGB；v2补充完整training/evaluation协议与matched training-cost测量。
analysis.experimentsZh: Qwen3-VL-Instruct2B/4B，15K（10K VSI/4K SPAR/1K MindCube），one epoch，LR1e-6，group8，λ.003。v2声明scene/question disjoint，16VSI frames，统一pixel budget；cost在2×96GB RTX PRO6000、111steps matched。 以下结果为作者报告：本次新增：作者报告GPD平均step40.3min、total74.6h，相对GRPO30.8min/57.1h为30.8% overhead，peak64.5vs64.4GB。（Appendix D.2 Table4, PDF p.13）；本次新增：作者报告末期validation response140.1vsGRPO171.7tokens（18.4%短）；旧VSI57.1对GRPO56.4及四bench37.6对35.7沿用，不是v2新增成绩。（Fig9, Tables1–2, PDF pp.5,12） 对照范围：受控GRPO/answer-only OPSD同data/backbone有解释力；general foundation references不同scale/data，不能同比复现。cost两模型配置有限，不支持大scale/其他家族结论。 消融与诊断：原Fig4分开answer/geometry、text/images/full/routed、λ及错误gate，未新增对应分数；v2补complete reward/validmask/prompts并量化成本。
analysis.insightZh: 原贡献是geometry privilege的question routing与incorrect-only OPSD；本次没有新方法/主bench分数，新增科学证据在训练成本与supervision noise边界，协议使该训练成本可追踪。
analysis.evidenceZh: BEV只在reliableposes/layout时构造，MindCube明确不给BEV；无validcue不伪造fallback。（Sec.3.2, Appendix A.1, PDF pp.3,10）；错误轨迹gate和scalar KL clipping避免给已正确rollouts额外noise。（Sec.3.3 Eqs.(4)–(7), Algorithm1, PDF pp.4,11）；v2新增matched training cost：40.3 vs30.8min/step，74.6 vs57.1h；64.5 vs64.4GB。（Appendix D.2 Table4, PDF p.13）；main VSI57.1/others37.6沿用v1，新增shorterresponse curve不证明内在geometry因果机制。（Tables1–2, Fig9, PDF pp.5,12–13；v1/v2 word delta）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 把真实3D训练监督移入RGB VLM而不改变推理输入，适用于design-agent geometry审阅参考；本轮新增训练成本与teacher reliability边界对实际采用有意义。
analysis.caveatZh: Appendix E新增：offline cue/router误差传播到teacher；15K mixture的scale行为未知；teacher hard-case token distribution可能错误；training re-scoring增加计算。；main gains小：4B VSI仅+0.7GRPO，无multi-seedCI；appendixresponse/privilege gap不是显式内部geometry因果证明。；reference answer与geometry一起给teacher，不能把所有token agreement当geometry正确性。；所有数字作者报告，未复现；无CAD/LEGO part geometry验证。
